reason: T lymphocytes do not express keratin; epithelial cells do not express CD3. Both markers measured in all 7 cohorts.
B lymphocytes (CD20/MS4A1) do not express keratin. Both markers measured in all 7 cohorts.
B and T lymphocytes are separate lineages; CD20 and CD3 are their textbook exclusive markers. Both measured in all 7 cohorts.

endothelial cells (CD31/PECAM1) are keratin-negative; epithelium is CD31-negative. CD31 is also on some immune cells, which does not matter here because the pair only tests CD31-high against keratin-high.

CD45 (PTPRC, pan epitope) marks all leukocytes; epithelium is CD45-negative. Pan-CD45 is measured in CRC, Keren, Phillips and UPMC only - Danenberg, ferguson and Sorin cannot be classified on this pair.
